name: Grade 7 IIT Practice: August Week 9 - Project Planning
description: Practice words for dance game planning and scoring.

words.definition: An early version used for testing.
words.example: The prototype tested one level before the full game was built.

words.definition: A guide that explains how work will be graded.
words.example: The rubric listed score, timer, and clear instructions.

words.definition: What you are trying to achieve.
words.example: The goal was to make a playable dance game.

words.definition: A smaller named part of a program that can be reused.
words.example: The subroutine repeated the same dance move when called.

words.definition: A tool or variable that tracks time.
words.example: The timer counted how long the player had to finish.

words.definition: A number that tracks points or progress.
words.example: The score showed how many correct moves the player made.
